4f:["$","ul","108",{"children":["\n",["$","li","1",{"children":[["$","strong","0",{"children":"Cannot connect:"}]," confirm that the host is running a matching server version, check the displayed IP and TCP port, and allow the connection through the host's firewall. A room code alone does not identify a server."]}],"\n",["$","li","3",{"children":[["$","strong","0",{"children":"Old modes or a version mismatch:"}]," stop the old background server before starting the new host package. Updating source files does not replace an already running process."]}],"\n",["$","li","5",{"children":[["$","strong","0",{"children":"Windows reports that the operation was canceled (1223):"}]," the executables are currently unsigned. Verify the release ZIP against its published SHA-256, unblock the downloaded ZIP in Windows file properties, and extract it again. The included ",["$","code","2",{"children":"repair-startup.bat"}]," can verify the package's executable checksums and unblock only those files after confirmation; it does not disable system protection. A checksum manifest is not a digital signature."]}],"\n",["$","li","7",{"children":[["$","strong","0",{"children":"The board does not fit:"}]," enlarge the terminal as directed by the size notice. Not every mode has a fully scrollable game view.
